name: makeit
description: makeit's plugin set: a tested set of Claude Code plugins, each external one recorded at the release it was tested with, which makeit moves to the newest release on every run; the bundles install them in one command.

plugins.name: makeit-bundle
plugins.description: Bundle: the day-to-day layer for every developer (makeit, superpowers, ponytail, chrome-devtools-mcp, deja-vu, security-audit, the four LSP plugins). Install at user scope.

plugins.name: makeit-ui
plugins.description: Bundle: what a UI repository adds (impeccable). Enable per project.

plugins.name: makeit
plugins.description: makeit's own plugin: hooks (handoff, docs version reminder, reply checks, notifications), the /makeit:init and expand-contract skills, and one MCP server with telemetry off (chrome-devtools, isolated).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers 7.0.1, tag v7.0.1, peeled commit recorded. MIT.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.2, tag v5.3.2 (lightweight; the commit is the pin), the commit measured on the hard test. MIT. Level full comes from PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE in settings.baseline.json.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: pbakaus/impeccable skill-v4.8.0 (the plugin lives under plugin/; 4.6.0 measured in stage 2, 2026-10-20). Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
plugins.description: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp 1.12.0: the 7 skills only. The source is the skills/ folder, which has no plugin.json, so this entry is the manifest and the upstream server (no CrUX flag) is never declared; makeit runs the one server, with telemetry and CrUX off. Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: deja-vu
plugins.description: vshulcz/deja-vu v0.24.1, commit 69abff8 (generated by cli/scripts/gen-deja-plugin.sh: keeps the session summary, PreCompact, SessionEnd, the MCP server, skills and /deja; drops the per-prompt and per-tool recall hooks; adds a one-line search hint). MIT. The plugin route writes no settings file; never run `deja install`.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: cloudflare/security-audit-skill, commit c1c8a8c on main (2026-09-14; no releases, no plugin.json: this entry is the manifest, the skills/ folder is scanned). MIT. Full codebase audit on request beside /security-review; added unmeasured (owner, 2026-10-26).
